site: Land north of Kingswood Road, Albrighton

conditions.title: Approval of reserved matters
conditions.plain: The council wants approval of the details for appearance, landscaping, layout, scale and access (except the Kingswood Road access point) before any building starts, and the work must be done as approved.
docs: details of appearance
details of landscaping
details of layout
details of scale
details of access, except the Kingswood Road access point
written approval from the council

conditions.title: Reserved matters deadline
conditions.plain: The council wants the detailed plans (reserved matters) submitted to the local planning authority within three years of the date of this permission.
docs: Application for approval of the reserved matters, submitted to the local planning authority

conditions.title: Time limit for starting development
conditions.plain: The council wants building work to start within two years after the last of the details that had to be approved later is approved.
docs: Start the development

conditions.title: Access point approval only
conditions.plain: The council is only approving the access point from Kingswood Road to the south. Everything else shown on the submitted plans is for illustration only and is not approved.
docs: No documents required - this condition only limits what is approved

conditions.title: Vehicular access and connections
conditions.plain: The council wants the main vehicle access to be only from Kingswood Road, plus required vehicle, walking and cycling links to nearby land called ALB002 and ALB021, and at least two more walking and cycling links, all inside the approved site edge. It does not say when this must be done.
docs: Approved Site Location Plan drawing ref: 9323-L-01 Rev D
SAMDev Plan, to identify ALB002
Draft development plan, to identify ALB021
Provide main vehicle access from Kingswood Road only
Provide vehicle, walking and cycling connection to ALB002 and ALB021 up to the site boundary, inside the approved site edge
Provide at least two additional walking and cycling accesses up to the site boundary, inside the approved site edge, next to Millfields

conditions.title: Housing mix report
conditions.plain: The council wants a report showing the proposed mix of homes meets local need, approved before or when the reserved matters are submitted. The scheme must then follow the approved report.
docs: report on the proposed housing mix and how it meets local housing need
details of the existing homes in Albrighton
explanation of how the proposed homes balance the size, type and ownership or rental mix of existing homes
numbers of MD4(2) and MD4(3) homes proposed
number of homes proposed to meet the national space standard
amount of specialist housing proposed

conditions.title: Parking strategy approval
conditions.plain: The council wants a parking strategy, showing car parking spaces per dwelling size, visitor parking, measures to reduce car use, and secure parking for bikes and mobility scooters, approved in writing before or when reserved matters are submitted.
docs: Parking strategy covering on-plot spaces per dwelling size
Visitor parking amounts
Measures to reduce reliance on private cars
Secure parking arrangements for bikes and mobility scooters

conditions.title: Landscaping details with reserved matters
conditions.plain: The council wants full details of hard and soft landscaping with the first reserved matters submission, and the approved landscaping must then be carried out as agreed. Any trees or shrubs that die or are badly damaged or diseased within five years must be replaced within 12 months with the same size and species.
docs: Planting plans, wildlife habitat creation and ecological enhancements (hibernacula, log piles, hedgehog-friendly gravel boards)
Tree and hedge planting scheme to BS 8545:2014 or current version

Details of trees and shrubs: species schedules (with scientific names), seed mixes, locations or density, planting pattern, stock type, size at planting, mulching, protection and support, planting period, date of completion, and post-planting maintenance and replacement measures
Specification and location of protective barriers to be installed before development starts (or other measures) to protect ground for planting
Written specifications for establishment of planting and habitat creation
Implementation timetables

conditions.title: Affordable housing location approval
conditions.plain: The council wants each layout application to show where the affordable homes will go on that part of the site, in line with the Section 106 Agreement, and no building work may start there until the council approves the location in writing.
docs: Layout showing the location of proposed affordable housing units on that part of the site
Affordable housing provided in accordance with the associated Section 106 Agreement
Written approval of the affordable housing location from the local planning authority before works commence

conditions.title: Reserved matters open space
conditions.plain: The council wants the first application for reserved matters to show the layout and provision of public open space, with at least 30 square metres per person, based on one person per bedroom.
docs: layout of public open space
provision of public open space
calculation of public open space using one person per bedroom

conditions.title: Domestic waste disposal arrangements
conditions.plain: The council wants the layout application to say how household waste will be disposed of. These arrangements must be followed while the development is being used.
docs: Household waste disposal arrangements
Include the arrangements in the layout application

conditions.title: Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment
conditions.plain: The council wants a noise and vibration report with the application for the layout, showing that future residents will be protected and identifying the measures needed. The noise reduction measures must be built into each dwelling before it is first occupied.
docs: Noise and Vibration Impact Assessment by a suitably qualified person
Identified noise reduction measures
Noise reduction measures carried out or installed before each dwelling is first occupied

conditions.title: Arboricultural survey and reports
conditions.plain: The council wants the reserved matters application to include tree reports and plans following British Standard 5837: 2012 (or its current version), and the building work must then follow what those approved documents say.
docs: Tree survey
Arboricultural Impact Assessment
Arboricultural Method Statement
Tree Protection Plan

conditions.title: Tree planting scheme
conditions.plain: The council wants a tree planting scheme, written to their satisfaction and following British Standard 8545: 2014 (or its current version), to be included with the reserved matters plans. Building work must then follow the approved scheme.
docs: Tree planting scheme prepared in line with British Standard 8545: 2014 (or current version), to the written satisfaction of the council

Details of trees and shrubs to be planted, including species, locations or density and planting pattern, type of planting stock, size at planting, means of protection and support, planting period and date of completion, and measures for post-planting maintenance and replacement of losses
Details of the specification and location of barriers (or other measures) to protect ground reserved for planting, to be installed before development starts

conditions.title: Landscape and habitat management plan
conditions.plain: The council wants a landscape and habitat management plan to be submitted and approved in writing before the development or any phase is occupied for its allowed use, whichever is sooner. The plan must cover all landscape areas except small, privately owned, domestic gardens, and must be carried out as approved.
docs: Landscape and habitat management plan
Long-term design objectives in the plan
Management responsibilities in the plan
Maintenance schedules in the plan for all landscape areas, except small, privately owned, domestic gardens
Written approval from the council
Carry out the approved plan

conditions.title: Ground levels and setting out details
conditions.plain: The council wants the reserved matters application to show existing and proposed ground and finished floor levels. For work next to site boundaries and existing homes, it also wants setting-out plans with distances to boundaries and ground levels at retained trees and hedges, and the build must follow approved details.
docs: Existing and proposed ground level details
Existing and proposed finished floor level details
Setting-out plans for buildings next to site boundaries and existing homes
Plans showing distances from buildings to boundaries of existing adjacent properties

conditions.title: Ghost island junction details
conditions.plain: The council wants full plans for the new ghost island junction and site access onto Kingswood Road, including the first 100 metres of access road north of the junction, approved in writing before the first reserved matters application is submitted.
docs: Topographical survey of the site access onto Kingswood Road
Full engineering details of the proposed ghost island junction on Kingswood Road
Engineering details of the proposed access road, including carriageway widths and forward visibility splays for the first 100 metres north of the junction
Swept path analysis for all engineering details
Stage 1/2 Road Safety Audit for all engineering details
Details of any tree removal or protection works

conditions.title: Kingswood Road engineering details
conditions.plain: The council wants full engineering details of the road improvements and traffic calming on Kingswood Road, as shown on drawing VN232896 D106 Rev A, approved in writing before any building work starts. The approved works must then be finished before the first home is occupied.
docs: Full engineering details of the Kingswood Road improvements and traffic calming measures, based on Drawing no. VN232896 D106 Rev A
Implementation of the approved works on site before the first dwelling is occupied

conditions.title: Beamish Lane access deterrence plan
conditions.plain: The council wants a full plan for the scheme to stop vehicles using Beamish Lane, including any signs and road markings at the A41 junction. It must be submitted for the council's written approval no later than the first reserved matters application.
docs: Full plan of the proposed scheme to deter vehicular access to Beamish Lane
Details of any signing and lining associated with the deterred access at the Beamish Lane and A41 junction
Written approval from the Local Planning Authority

conditions.title: Badger mitigation strategy
conditions.plain: The council wants a badger mitigation strategy submitted and approved in writing at least six months before development starts. The strategy must include an updated survey by a qualified and experienced ecologist and set out the actions to be taken during the works, and the approved actions must be carried out.
docs: badger mitigation strategy
updated badger survey by a qualified and experienced ecologist
written approval from the council
approved actions carried out during the works

conditions.title: Construction Environmental Management Plan (Biodiversity)
conditions.plain: The council wants a Construction Environmental Management Plan (Biodiversity) approved in writing before any work starts on site, including ground works and vegetation clearance. Once approved, all construction must follow the plan exactly.
docs: Construction Environmental Management Plan (Biodiversity) including:
Scaled plan showing Wildlife/Habitat Protection Zones where construction is restricted and where protective measures will be installed
Details of protective measures (physical measures and sensitive working practices) to avoid impacts during construction, including for badgers, bats and great crested newts
Details of any site lighting required during the construction phase
Timetable showing phasing of construction activities to avoid harm to biodiversity features
Times during construction when an ecological clerk of works must be on site to oversee works

conditions.title: Construction management plan
conditions.plain: The council wants a construction management plan, with a method statement, approved in writing before any building work starts, and the approved plan must then be followed for the whole build.
docs: Construction management plan incorporating a method statement covering: construction programme and phasing; 24 hour emergency contact number; hours of operation; noise and dust control measures; expected number and type of vehicles; arrangements for deliveries, waste, cranes, equipment, plant, works and visitors; size of construction vehicles; consolidation scheme for deliveries; measures to reduce vehicle movements and street parking including access for neighbouring occupiers; construction traffic routes avoiding weight and size restrictions; loading/unloading and waiting/holding areas and communication for delivery vehicles; storage locations for plant, waste and materials; arrangements for abnormal loads; temporary traffic management measures; mud prevention on the highway; communication of the plan to staff, visitors and neighbours

conditions.title: Site investigation and remediation
conditions.plain: The council wants the site checked for contamination before any building work starts, and any contamination found must be cleaned up and proven safe to the council's satisfaction. Reports must be approved in writing at each stage.
docs: Site Investigation Report, by a competent person following Environment Agency guidance, submitted and approved in writing before development starts
Remediation Strategy, if contamination is found, submitted and approved in writing
Carry out the clean-up works in line with the approved Remediation Strategy
Report any newly found contamination in writing immediately, with investigation and risk assessment, and a remediation scheme approved in writing if needed
Verification Report after the clean-up is finished, submitted and approved in writing to show the contamination has been made safe

conditions.title: Archaeological written scheme of investigation
conditions.plain: The council wants a written scheme for archaeological work approved before any building starts, and that work must then be carried out as set out in the scheme.
docs: Written scheme of investigation approved in writing by the Planning Authority
Secure implementation of programme of archaeological work in accordance with written scheme of investigation

conditions.title: Phasing plan
conditions.plain: The council wants the development to follow a phasing plan. The plan must be submitted and approved in writing before any development starts.
docs: Phasing plan
Written approval from the Local Planning Authority

conditions.title: Surface and foul water drainage scheme
conditions.plain: Before work starts on each phase, submit a drainage scheme for surface water and waste water and get it approved in writing by the council. Build and use the approved scheme, and keep it maintained for the life of the development.

details showing the scheme would not cause stability problems on land next to the railway

development undertaken in accordance with the approved details
approved scheme fully implemented before dwellings are first occupied

conditions.title: Railway ground levels details
conditions.plain: Before any building work starts, the council must be given and approve in writing the full details of ground levels, earthworks and excavations within 10 metres of the railway, and the work must follow those approved details.

conditions.title: Scaffolding method statement and risk assessment
conditions.plain: The council wants a method statement and risk assessment approved in writing before any works start on site. They must include details of scaffolding within 10m of the railway boundary, and the build must follow the approved details.

risk assessment

conditions.title: Estate street construction details
conditions.plain: The council wants full engineering, drainage, street lighting and construction details for any new estate street planned to be taken over by the council to be submitted and approved in writing before work starts. The street must then be built to the approved details, unless the council agrees changes in writing.

conditions.title: Piling and compaction risk assessment
conditions.plain: If any piling or ground compaction is needed, the council must approve in writing a risk assessment and plan for how the work will be done before that work starts. The plan must also confirm that occupiers and businesses next to the site have been told the planned duration and hours and given contact details, and the work must follow the approved details.

conditions.title: Estate street phasing plan
conditions.plain: The council wants a plan showing the phases of the development and the standards the new estate streets will be finished to, for each phase. This plan must be approved in writing before any work on a new estate street starts.
docs: Estate street phasing and completion plan, setting out the development phases and the standards estate streets serving each phase will be completed to

conditions.title: New Travel Plan approval
conditions.plain: The council wants a full Travel Plan for the development, including a timetable, bus strategy and yearly traffic counts at the Kingswood Road access, approved before anyone moves in. The plan must then be followed as approved, any changes need the council's prior written approval, and yearly progress reports must be sent for ten years from first occupation.

conditions.title: Play areas and open space scheme
conditions.plain: Before the first home in each phase is occupied, the team must submit details of play areas and open space, plus a delivery timetable, and get written approval from the council. The approved work must then be built, kept in place, and used only as approved.

conditions.title: External lighting plan
conditions.plain: Before any external lighting is put up in a development phase, a lighting plan must be approved in writing by the council. The approved lighting must be built exactly as approved and kept for the life of the development.

conditions.plain: The council wants details of a trespass-proof fence or boundary treatment along the railway boundary, plus a phasing and maintenance plan, approved before occupation. conditions.plain: Before anyone moves into or uses the buildings, the council must approve in writing the makes, models and locations of bat, bird, invertebrate and hedgehog boxes, and the required boxes must then be put up and kept in good condition for the life of the development.

conditions.title: Protection of retained trees
conditions.plain: The council wants retained trees, shrubs and hedges not to be deliberately damaged, destroyed, uprooted, felled, lopped, topped or cut back unless the approved plans allow it or the council gives written approval first. This applies until the application for the remaining details is submitted and approved in full.
docs: Approved plans and details
Written council approval before any tree work
Tree work carried out to British Standard 3998:2010 or current version

conditions.title: Construction working hours restriction
conditions.plain: The council wants construction and other works to take place only between 08:00 and 18:00 Monday to Friday, and between 08:00 and 13:00 on Saturdays. They must not take place on Sundays or Bank Holidays.
docs: work only during the allowed hours
